name: The Daily Fold
tagline: Your news, typeset as a real newspaper for foldable phones.
description: The Daily Fold collects the news from the sources you choose and prints it like a real paper, with columns, headlines and photographs. Open your foldable and read a two-page spread; turn pages with a paper curl. The front pages tease the most interesting stories from every section, then each story follows in full, section by section, in the order you set.

platforms.requires: Android 10 or later. Made for foldables, works on any phone

features.title: A real front page
features.text: Teasers of the day's most interesting stories from every section, each with the page where it continues in full.

features.title: Stories in full, in your order
features.text: Sections follow in the order you choose, every story printed whole, page after page. No jumping between pages.

features.title: Turn pages like paper
features.text: Swipe, tap or draw a small quarter circle with your thumb. One-handed and left-handed modes keep every gesture in reach.

features.title: Your sources
features.text: Pick from a directory by section and language, or type any site's address and the app finds its feed.

features.title: AI briefing
features.text: On phones with on-device AI, such as the Pixel 9 and 10, the best stories are summed up in a few pages. Nothing leaves the phone.

features.title: Make it yours
features.text: Newspaper styles, fonts, text size, columns, night mode, a blue-light filter and black and white.

setup: Download the file on your phone and open it.
If Android asks, allow your browser to install apps.
Choose your languages and sections, and your first paper is printed.
limits: The AI briefing only appears on phones that have on-device AI available to apps.
Some sites only publish a short teaser, so their stories stay short.
Android will warn that the app comes from an unknown source.
